description: E-422 (D-155 r3; release-artifact.md §Data Model 'Settings a profile's settings.json may receive from the app'; contract §2.3): what the app may write into a Claude profile's <config_dir>/settings.json. A write is accepted only when every top-level key it adds, changes or removes is one of enabledPlugins, extraKnownMarketplaces, attribution; every other key must come out byte-for-byte as it went in. hooks, autoMode, permissions and defaultMode are refused by name: the gate's hook entries live in each project's .claude/settings.json (rein init / rein sync), never in a profile. before = the file as found; after = the file the app would write; expected = accept | refuse.

cases.label: enable a plugin in an empty profile
set attribution, leave the operator's other keys alone
any other key outside the allow-list
an allowed key together with a refused one
